title: Semantic invariants: Short-circuit non-evaluation
description: Short-circuit invariant: the right operand of false and X must never be evaluated, verified using division by zero as observable effect.

steps.description: Generator: given generates exprs for the right-hand side.
Test function: test_short_circuit with rhs parameter.
Comment: false and (1/0 ...) must NOT raise.
Assertion: build tree with LogicOp and div_by_zero_wrapping, evaluate must return False with no exception.
